facts.business: E.I.D.-Parry (India) Limited is a diversified company engaged in sugar manufacturing, biofuel (ethanol), consumer products, and nutraceuticals, with operations across Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh.
key_risks: Climate variability and erratic rainfall affecting sugarcane cultivation
Water scarcity in sugarcane growing regions
Farmers shifting to alternative crops (paddy, oil palm)
Structural challenges in cane availability in Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh
Foreign currency exchange rate fluctuations (USD exposure)
facts.related_party_note: Amount due from private companies in which the Holding Company's directors are directors is ₹ Nil lakhs (March 31, 2025: ₹ 39 lakhs). Trade receivables include related party dues as per Note 52.6.
